queue.title: How the queue is built
queue.bodyActivation: Re-evaluated every 15 min by the D1 of the three closed cohorts from D−4 to D−2 of the recruiters active anywhere in the HQ, with no 10 min AFK. It sums the retained and the hired and divides once. Ties: more retained in absolute numbers, then more recruiters at the waypoint. With fewer than 3 hires summed it ranks below anyone with a sample, by activation. Recruiter proximity to the waypoint is temporarily not required.
queue.bodyLegacy: Re-evaluated every 15 min. Ties first use more active recruiters within the waypoint radius and then the highest absolute number of retained players, without dropping whoever is already in focus.
queue.example: A recruiter is a member with a level 3 or higher rank in the gang panel.

entry.title: What a gang needs to get in
entry.bodyActivation: Activation ≥ 20% of the beginners hired in the last 48h, with or without a waypoint. Only hires longer than 60 min count: at least 1h in the first session. No minimum sample; without a mature hire it does not qualify. It requires the minimum online, 3 active members at the HQ, fewer than 40 online and no lock or blacklist.
entry.bodyLegacy: 10 hires over the 7 days, D1 ≥ 30%, the minimum online and 3 active members at the HQ; plus being below 40 online and outside the lock or blacklist.
entry.example: A member below level 3 counts towards the 3 active ones, but not as a recruiter.

batch.title: How much it receives
batch.body: It receives up to {{spawnLimit}} beginners per focus or until it reaches 40 online, whichever comes first.
batch.example: E.g.: it enters with 10 online and receives {{spawnLimit}}; it enters with 38 and leaves upon reaching 40. When it returns to the focus, the batch starts from zero.

exit.title: Why it leaves the focus
exit.body: The order of exits is: low conversion, {{spawnLimit}} spawns or 40 online, losing the HQ and losing the minimum online. The online count is checked every 5 min.
exit.example: Conversion: only checked with at least {{sample}} beginners who spawned at the HQ more than {{maturity}} min ago. Below 45%, it leaves with a 45 min blacklist.

cooldown.title: After receiving the batch or reaching 40
cooldown.body: It stays 30 minutes out of the filter, including across midnight. Low conversion triggers a 45 minute blacklist.
cooldown.example: There is no spawn limit per hour or per day.

fallback.title: If nobody passes the filter
fallback.bodyActivation: Among the gangs below 40 online, the one with the most active members at the HQ gets in, ignoring activation, the online floor, the HQ minimum, the lock and the blacklist. Ties: highest activation, then lowest online.
fallback.bodyLegacy: Among the gangs below 40 online, the one with the most active members at the HQ gets in, ignoring the other filters.
fallback.example: The fallback does not leave because of the online floor or the HQ. Every 5 min it yields to a qualified gang; it remains subject to conversion, the {{spawnLimit}} spawns and the 40 online. After a low conversion it prefers another gang; it only repeats if it is the only one.
